## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: In format_ticket_id(), _repo_root (for config file) and _repo_root2 (for tracker dir) each independently call git rev-parse --show-toplevel. When both WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE and TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR env vars are absent, two git subprocesses are spawned sequentially. A single shared variable would halve this overhead.
File: plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh
data.title: ticket-lib.sh: format_ticket_id() calls git rev-parse twice when both WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE and TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR are unset
